reason: Both drop the unsupported "cut in half" claim and ask about the signed-records paper trail, but A fits this HR screener better: it tells the writer to put "GMP" and "training records" honestly in the gap paragraph, asks whether GMP coursework is already under way (it is), and surfaces the June start date.
